topic: Review of packet 069 (llmgateway DeepSeek V4.1 Flash route repoint)

focus: Full-dimension pass (correctness, security, traceability, maintainability) over packet 069 and its verification claims

findingDetails.title: Retired id still named on a non-changelog surface (traceability)
findingDetails.evidence: Lines 29 and 46 declare 'default is deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp' as the PI-017 expectation, while executor-config.ts:214 sets PI_DEFAULT_MODEL = 'deepseek-v4.1-flash'. REQ-001 and AC-001 (acceptance-criteria.md:57) claim the scan returned no hit.
findingDetails.recommendation: Update both rows to the live id, re-run the retired-id sweep over non-changelog surfaces including playbooks, and correct AC-001's evidence cell with the real scope and result.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Scanned .opencode and .pi for the retired literal (14 files), classified every hit as OpenRouter-prefixed, changelog, regex-assertion or bare-stale, and read the two playbook rows plus the config default they contradict.

findingDetails.title: Recorded retired-id scan evidence is overstated (traceability)
findingDetails.evidence: AC-001's Verification cell and implementation-summary.md:138 both say the only surviving match is the OpenRouter-prefixed literal; two bare hits survive at supported-model-allowlist-smoke.md:29,46.
findingDetails.recommendation: Restate the scan with its real scope and outcome after F001 is fixed; do not cite a scan whose predicate excludes the file that fails it.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Re-ran the scan twice (bare literal, any literal) and checked whether the playbook pre- or post-dates the recorded scan; it is tracked, unmodified, and targets the current config path.

findingDetails.title: Handover trap "pi has no `--mode text`" is false (traceability)
findingDetails.evidence: handover.md:125 records 'pi has no --mode text' as load-bearing and repeats it at :153 and :171; the installed parser accepts it (dist/cli/args.js:42) and documents it as the default (dist/cli/args.js:274).
findingDetails.recommendation: Replace the trap with its true form (print mode is the non-interactive flag; --mode defaults to text) and drop the two comments denying it, so correct usages such as .pi/custom-providers.md:127 are not 'fixed'.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Read the full flag parser to check whether text is accepted-but-ignored, and enumerated the repository's --mode text usages to size the blast radius.

findingDetails.title: Validator warning misattributed to AC_COVERAGE (traceability)
findingDetails.evidence: handover.md:211 and :267 name AC_COVERAGE as the single warning; the rule is declared info-severity and keeps RULE_STATUS=pass on every advisory path (validator-registry.json; check-ac-coverage.sh:464-495; orchestrator.ts:275-286), so it cannot surface as a warning. FRONTMATTER_MEMORY_BLOCK is the reachable warner (orchestrator.ts:942; spec-doc-structure.ts:685-880) and has five warning-severity diagnostics on this packet.
findingDetails.recommendation: Copy the real Summary line and warning rule id from the next validator run into §4/§5; if the FRONTMATTER_MEMORY_BLOCK diagnosis holds, shorten the five continuity fields it names.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Checked both paths by which the AC rule could warn (explicit warn status, and the fail-to-info severity mapping), and read the registry entry plus the memory-block rule's diagnostic severities.

findingDetails.title: AC-coverage counts wrong in the handover (traceability)
findingDetails.evidence: handover.md:267 claims 16 of 21 flagged with 6 from the first pass; the rule's own analyzer returns rows=21 covered=6 malformed=15 with seven first-pass ids and all eight second-pass ids flagged.
findingDetails.recommendation: Correct the counts and the conclusion; the AC-evidence deficit is mostly this pass's work, not a predecessor's.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Executed the rule's own _ac_analyze_canonical parser against the packet's acceptance-criteria.md and mapped the flagged id list onto the first-pass and second-pass ranges.

findingDetails.title: Pi default-provider claim contradicts settings.json (maintainability)
findingDetails.evidence: The roster and .pi/custom-providers.md:27,35,67,152 say pi's defaultProvider is cline-pass; .pi/settings.json:4 sets llmgateway. The roster sentence was edited in this pass and the claim carried through.
findingDetails.recommendation: State the real default in both documents; then settle whether llmgateway plus z-ai/glm-5.3-flash resolves, since that pair is not a declared model id for the provider.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Checked for a second settings scope (the user-level file is a symlink to the same .pi/settings.json) and confirmed via git diff that the packet's enabledModels edit did not touch defaultProvider.

findingDetails.title: Duplicated closure paragraph in the acceptance criteria (maintainability)
findingDetails.evidence: The paragraph beginning 'One thing is left open rather than closed' appears at :126-129 and again at :135 in the same section, with no cross-reference and no distinct content.
findingDetails.recommendation: Delete one copy; the same edit can carry the F002 evidence correction.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Compared both passages word by word and checked for a summarising or list context that would justify the repetition; neither paragraph has one.

results.summary: REQ-002/003/006/007/009 resolve to shipped code and recorded probes; REQ-001 does not, because one non-changelog surface still names the retired id.
Checklist items are marked without per-item file:line evidence; the packet-level runs are recorded, and 15 of 21 acceptance criteria lack citations.
Target type is spec-folder; no skill/agent pair in scope.
No catalog claim depends on this change.
The id-format control was updated; the allowlist-smoke scenario's expected default contradicts shipped behavior.

noveltyJustification: Seven findings, none a restatement of the packet's recorded known limitations: two coverage gaps found by scanning rather than trusting the packet's scan, three refuted continuity claims, one doc-vs-config contradiction in an edited line, one editing duplication.
ruledOut: OpenRouter-prefixed literals as REQ-001 violations (documented exclusion, spec.md:65)
Pin-pattern triplication as a new defect (documented, implementation-summary.md §6 item 4)
Missing checklist.md as a Level 2 defect (not required at Level 2; tasks.md carries the checklist)
cline-pass over-claiming (rows say listing-only and name blocker plus fallback)
Version-anchor drift (SKILL.md versions match newest changelogs)
